name: The Strokes

whyMatters.en: Tight drums, leather cool, Is This It production: The Strokes open the door for the 2000s NYC garage and post-punk revival.
whyMatters.zh: 紧鼓点、皮衣冷感、Is This It 的制作：The Strokes 为 2000s 纽约车库与后朋克复兴推开那扇门。

note.zh: 双吉他咬合的都市夜晚

interviewQuotes.text: We just wanted to make cool music.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Julian Casablancas

lyricQuotes: Last night she said, oh baby I don't know

shortBio.en: NYC switch for the 2000s guitar revival.

body.en:
Five downtown silhouettes, songs that sound like they were recorded in a cool basement on purpose. The Strokes make early-2000s guitar cool feel inevitable again.

After them, a wave has a shared aesthetic entrance—hair, snap, restraint.
body.zh:
五个下城剪影，歌听起来像故意录在凉爽地下室。The Strokes 让世纪初的吉他酷感再次显得必然。

在他们之后，一股浪潮有了统一审美入口——发型、干脆、克制。

body.en:
Is This It arrives like a rumor that turns out true: short songs, interlocking guitars, Casablancas half-awake on the mic. Garage and post-punk memory become a present tense uniform.

Decisive as ignition—others pour through the same doorway.
body.zh:
Is This It 像一则最终证实的谣言：短歌、咬合吉他、Casablancas 半醒着贴麦。车库与后朋克记忆变成现在时制服。

决定性在点火——别人从同一扇门涌入。

title.en: Last Nite: the revival's calling card

body.en:
A riff that nods at older rooms without paying full rent. Last Nite becomes the global postcard of the revival—recognizable in three seconds, cool in thirty.

This is how a local NYC temperature becomes export weather.
body.zh:
一段向旧房间点头却不全额付租的 riff。Last Nite 成为复兴的全球明信片——三秒能认，三十秒够酷。

本地纽约气温，就这样变成出口天气。

body.en:
Valensi and Hammond interlocking like traffic lights arguing. Reptilia is the downtown night in motion—tight, slightly mean, impossible to over-explain.

The revival's body language lives in that bite.
body.zh:
Valensi 与 Hammond 像抬杠的红绿灯咬合。Reptilia 是移动中的下城夜晚——紧、略凶、不必过度解释。

复兴的身体语言，住在那一口咬合里。

body.en:
Upstream: NYC cool from older decades, Television nerves, CBGB dust. Downstream: Arctic Monkeys and a thousand tight-trouser bands learning restraint as style.

The Strokes are less a genre than a permission slip for looking sharp while playing simple.
body.zh:
上游：更早几十年的纽约酷、Television 神经、CBGB 灰尘。下游：Arctic Monkeys 与一千支紧身裤乐队学会把克正当风格。

The Strokes 与其说是流派，不如说是许可：弹得简单也可以看起来锋利。

body.en:
Casablancas quotes arrive half-swallowed, which somehow makes them doctrine for a decade of cool. The band talks less than the silhouette suggests.

Pin the mumble. The aesthetic was always economy.
body.zh:
Casablancas 的话半吞半吐到场，却莫名成为十年酷感教义。乐队说话比剪影暗示的更少。

钉住含糊。美学本来就是节省。

note.en: Garage revival as downtown cool reset.
note.zh: Garage 复兴：市中心酷感重置。

note.en: Tight jeans, tighter songs—indie becomes a look again.
note.zh: 紧身牛仔裤与更紧的歌——indie 再度成为造型。
